name: app-sidebar
title: App Sidebar
author: @fma-ds/ds
description:
An app-shell sidebar block, collapsible to icons: a team switcher (or a static logo), navigation sections and a user menu.

`data` holds the user and the teams or logo. The menus are `children`, composed from `AppSidebarSection`, `AppSidebarItem` and `AppSidebarSubItem`. Render it inside a `SidebarProvider`.

- **Sub-items**: expand inline (`variant="collapse"`) or open a menu (`"dropdown"`, and always while collapsed to icons).
- **Links**: react-aria `Link`s; wrap the app in `RouterProvider` for client-side routing.
- **Menus**: `onTeamChange`, `onAddTeam` and `onUserAction` handle them.
- **Access**: `access` is what an item does (`granted`, `blocked`, `gated`), `badge` says why, with the app's own text, and `external` opens it in a new tab. To hide an item, don't render it. `gated` is informative only: the item links to `href`, and the app must guard that route.
- **Empty parents**: an item or section with no children isn't rendered. That's counted on direct children, so `{can && <Item />}` works, but a wrapper of yours that returns `null` still counts as one.

meta.origin: shadcn/ui block sidebar-07, rebuilt on the registry's react-aria Sidebar, Collapsible and DropdownMenu
